snippet.title: Mayor May Knott Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
A genre-bending, "creepy-cozy", 3D adventure game, where a shy girl accidentally becomes mayor of a haunted ghost town... filled with TERRIFYING MONSTERS!

Explore the town, play minigames, solve puzzles, and interact with 30+ bizarre characters to turn the creepy ghost town into a cozy community... filled with TERRIFYING MONSTERS!

🎮 Play the demo now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3955630
